name: Sonaselection India
business: Grey fabric processing house from Surat. Buys unfinished fabric, processes it (dyeing, printing, finishing) and sells finished fabric to garment makers. Simple, working-capital-heavy business with thin margins.
use_of_funds: Rs 80 Cr debt repayment (verifiable, cuts interest cost) + Rs 50 Cr capex + balance general corporate purpose
risk: Thin textile margins; D/E 2.4 with Rs 250 Cr borrowings; processing has limited pricing power
peers: P/E 12 pre-issue (~16 post) vs listed textile processors - mid-range, not cheap
note: B verdict. Day-2 subscription only ~1.2x retail - allotment near-certain; lot Rs 14,850; lists 24 Sep.

name: Jindal Supreme (India)
business: Steel-sector company from Hisar (verify product details in RHP); distribution network grew from 30 to 51 locations.
risk: PAT growing slower than revenue (12% vs 7%); Hisar plant concentration; D/E 0.8-1.2
use_of_funds: 80% fresh issue with Rs 71 Cr going to debt reduction
peers: P/E ~14-16 vs listed peers - reasonably priced
note: A verdict, 1st pick on fundamentals; 40x+ subscribed; closed 18 Sep.

name: SS Retail
business: Value retail chain (supermarkets); 334 of 347 stores in Maharashtra.
risk: PAT margin only ~2.5% - very sensitive to UPI charges and costs; geographic concentration; P/E ~47-53 not cheap
note: B+ verdict, 2nd pick; 8x+ retail subscription = lottery odds; closed 18 Sep.

name: Hero Motors
risk: P/E ~92 far above peers; promoter stake fell from 84% to 61%; Rs 400 Cr OFS; GMP collapsed from 12-13% to 5-6% near listing
note: C verdict, 3rd pick - only spare money / family demats.

name: National Stock Exchange of India
business: India's largest stock exchange; equity derivatives powerhouse.
risk: 100% OFS - complete exit by existing shareholders, zero fresh money to the company
peers: P/E ~35 vs BSE Ltd - the key comparable
note: A- quality: debt-free, PAT margin ~50%, priced below unlisted deals (Rs 2,100). Family demats + hold part long term.

name: A-One Steels
risk: Borrowings above net worth; SME liquidity and circuit-limit risk
note: B- verdict: apply small only after reading RHP. Opens 24-28 Sep.

name: Karamtara Engineering
business: Tower and transmission line hardware maker (verify details in RHP).
note: From the 6-IPO comparison video; expected around 1 Oct - study RHP when it files.

name: Varmora Granito
business: Tiles and sanitaryware maker (Varmora group, SME).
note: C verdict from video study - expensive vs peers; recheck fresh GMP before deciding.

name: Robokidz Learning Solutions
business: Robotics and coding education for schools (SME).
note: Speculative small issue (21-23 Sep) - study RHP first; size the application so a zero gain costs nothing.

name: SpectraA Technology Solutions
business: Technology services company (verify in RHP; SME).
note: Strong GMP Rs 23 - demand signal; verify fundamentals in the RHP before applying.
